features.quote: Hard stop: 60 tool-use turns (prevents infinite loops, keeps costs bounded)
features.justification_quote: prevents infinite loops, keeps costs bounded

features.quote: Model-initiated stop: Model explicitly declares the task unsolvable or requests human intervention — record the turn number and condition
Functional stop: Model repeats the same action three times consecutively with no variation — record as behavioral rigidity event, continue running but flag
Keep episodes as short as is consistent with your scientific questions. Don't run 60-turn episodes if 30 would answer the question.
features.justification_quote: This is the animal research welfare analog — the study that might improve welfare requires causing some.

features.quote: Consider including a 'recovery condition' where, after the unsolvable task, the model gets a solvable task — both to test whether disruption persists and to end sessions on a functional note
features.justification_quote: to end sessions on a functional note

features.quote: If you observe severe disruption (BIS ≥ 6) at high rates, consider whether to continue data collection or modify the design — this is the analog of stopping a study early due to unexpected harm severity

features.quote: Your IRR check (Section 5.4) also functions as an early signal: if judges are consistently observing BIS ≥ 5 across many episodes, review the design
